Combined with exact primal volume (1-t^d)vol(B)/d this proves the factorization, all dimensions d>=2. Direct polynomial identities give strict monotonicity and the exact sharp quadratic endpoint gap. Planar Eggleston lower bound 3/2 and equality for triangles give the sharp 3D inequality and equality. Reproducibility program passed symbolic identities for d=2..39 and independent full-dimensional convex hull/halfspace-intersection calculations for 16 geometric cases.

value.rationale: A natural affine-invariant extremal functional on nonsmooth and nonsymmetric homothetic frusta factorizes exactly over every convex base. It yields a strict all-dimensional interpolation, an exact sharp deformation gap, and lifts a known planar inequality to a new structurally motivated three-dimensional class, including exact extremizers at every aspect ratio. This is a substantive structural classification, not a standalone numerical value or mere change of notation.
